title: Large Language Models Are Partially Primed in Pronoun Interpretation

bias_targets.methodology: Replicating psycholinguistic experiments using an in-context learning (ICL) framework to measure whether LLMs prefer resolving ambiguous pronouns to the syntactic subject, and evaluating if this preference adapts after exposure to consistent subject-biased versus non-subject-biased referential patterns.

Using an in-context learning framework with stories about transfer-of-possession events to test whether LLMs prefer resolving ambiguous pronouns to the semantic goal (over the source), and measuring adaptation after exposure to goal-biased versus source-biased referential patterns.
